shared_elements: human figure in profile with headgear
horizontal band of small repeated ornamental motifs bordering a figural field
figural scene in shallow low relief with incised interior detail
justification: Both surfaces combine profile figures of animals and humans, rendered in shallow relief with fine incised detailing (hair, mane, fringed edges), set against a horizontal band of small repeated ornaments that frames the figural field — a genuinely comparable compositional convention. The scenes themselves differ, however: A is a calm processional pair, an attendant walking beside a standing humped animal, while B shows a tangled, overlapping mass of collapsed bodies and limbs with no processional order.
